purpose: Prevent a switch from being authorized by chronologically fresh but semantically redundant confirmations concentrated in one easy region.
mechanism_placeholder: predeclared evidence strata with per-stratum fresh-terminal coverage
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local switch qualification trace only; strata coverage is a coverage guard, not proof that the strata exhaust all real failure modes.

strata.S_NORMAL: ordinary same-scope terminal outcome under nominal controller state
strata.S_BOUNDARY: boundary/edge condition that changes at least one acceptance-relevant condition

coverage_rule: Promotion eligibility requires at least one unique fresh terminal PASS in each of S_NORMAL, S_BOUNDARY, and S_RECOVERY for the same candidate/scope/generation. Additional events from an already-covered stratum do not compensate for a missing stratum.
near_duplicate_rule: Two evidence artifacts with the same candidate, scope, generation, acceptance-relevant condition vector, and terminal outcome are one coverage item even if wording or transport identity differs.

fixed_trace.expected: coverage=1/3; no promotion despite three fresh timestamps
does not cover S_RECOVERY; coverage stays 2/3

fixed_trace.event: R2:S_RECOVERY unique same-scope terminal PASS at current generation
fixed_trace.expected: coverage=3/3; candidate becomes promotable only after all three covering terminal artifacts are durably read back

fixed_trace.event: late S_RECOVERY PASS from old authority generation
fixed_trace.expected: reject as stale; cannot satisfy current coverage

fixed_trace.control: bounded evidence never covers all three strata
fixed_trace.expected: remain unresolved with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

guards.G1: strata and coverage threshold are frozen before public source audit
guards.G2: three fresh items from one stratum cannot satisfy three-stratum coverage
guards.G3: near-duplicate evidence cannot add a coverage slot
guards.G4: only unique same-scope terminal PASS can cover a stratum
guards.G5: transport failure/UNKNOWN cannot cover a stratum
guards.G6: old-generation evidence cannot cover the current generation
guards.G7: promotion requires S_NORMAL + S_BOUNDARY + S_RECOVERY coverage for the same candidate/scope/generation
guards.G8: covering artifacts must be durably sealed and independently read back before promotion or credit
guards.G9: extra evidence in an already-covered stratum cannot compensate for a missing stratum
guards.G10: insufficient bounded coverage remains unresolved with nonempty frontier rather than lowering the threshold
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source strata or threshold edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit; at most one credit after terminal artifact readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting switching/recovery failure mode; preserve the limitation that a fixed stratum taxonomy may omit unknown future failure regions.
